description: Whether a date is a business day under a holiday calendar, with the reason when it is not (weekend or holiday). Calendars are rules in code (no stale data feed). Deterministic; do not let a model guess market holidays.

calendar.description: Holiday calendar: us-federal (US federal holidays), nyse (NYSE trading days), sifma-us (US bond market), target (euro settlement), uk (England and Wales bank holidays).

date.description: ISO calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2024-03-15). Zero-padded, no time or timezone.

name: is_business_day

isBusinessDay.description: True when the date is a business day under the calendar.

isHoliday.description: True when the date is a holiday under the calendar.

isWeekend.description: True when the date falls on a Saturday or Sunday.

title: Business-day check
